card.name: The word how after know/learn/and
card.fires_on: The word "how" introducing a clause after verbs like learn, know or study, after "and" following a knowledge phrase, or after a colon in a book subtitle.

modes.label: How after knowing or learning
modes.description: "how" follows a verb of knowing, learning or studying and leads into a "how to" or "how X works" clause.
modes.example: Find a doctor who knows<< how>> to treat vitiligo.

modes.label: How after "and" in prescriber wording
modes.description: "how" follows "and" after a phrase about knowing the use of opioids, then "to mitigate the risks".
modes.example: should be prescribed only by healthcare professionals who are knowledgeable about the use of opioids and<< how>> to mitigate the associated risks.

modes.label: How opening a book subtitle
modes.description: "How" starts the subtitle after a colon in a book title.
modes.example: His new book, The Magic of Reality:<< How>> We Know Whats Really True

card.writes: It promotes odd, unrelated tokens and suppresses size words like long, wide and tall, so the effect is unclear beyond blocking size adjectives after "how".
card.plain: It fires on the word "how" when it means the way something is done or works, as in "know how to".
